architecture: call-workflow safe output compiles to a job (`call-smoke-workflow-call` in smoke-call-workflow.lock.yml) that runs `uses: ./.github/workflows/smoke-workflow-call.lock.yml` nested inside the SAME orchestrator run id (compile-time fan-out). The worker's own independent run list (schedule/workflow_dispatch only) never contains workflow_call-context executions; those are only observable as a nested job inside smoke-call-workflow's run history.

worker.goal: Validate PR branch checkout in reusable workflow_call context.
worker.acceptance: Independent checkout-state evidence matches the intended caller PR head and initialized Git state.
worker.designLimitation: Git commands working or a PASS comment cannot prove the intended PR was checked out.

orchestrator.goal: Validate reusable-worker invocation and checkout through call-workflow.
orchestrator.acceptance: Independent invocation and checkout evidence confirms the requested worker and task input reached the intended context.
orchestrator.designLimitation: A dispatch safe output alone does not demonstrate correct worker checkout.

coupling.mechanism: compile-time fan-out via the call-workflow safe output
coupling.workerEligibilityFloorReason: Before the orchestrator existed, no workflow_call coupling to the worker was possible regardless of the worker's own earlier standalone adoption.

rejectedProxies: a PASS/FAIL comment footer written by the agent itself
the call_workflow safe-output count alone (dispatch without confirmed destination/input match)
the worker's own schedule/workflow_dispatch run history (never reflects workflow_call context)
editable issue/PR body or comment text
limitations: Actions run/job/log-level evidence (run lists, job steps, and logs for both workflows) could not be acquired in this measurement environment; see acquisition below.
Repository, commit, blob, and adoption facts above were independently verified via unauthenticated public git smart-HTTP clone plus SHA1 blob hashing, which remained reachable.
Complete attribution and cost accounting remain not-measured.
